steps.name: Colors of Emotion (12)
steps.objective: Talk to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」, then turn in the quest to [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You're awake...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I had a lot on my mind.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: How are you feeling now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right. But Pneuma...
(Around where Arche stands, the sky, the earth, and the distant spirits are moving vigorously as usual.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Please don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Hecate threatened you and Pneuma.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I don't know what her intentions are, but things have returned to normal for now... So I'm trying to think of it as all right.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Pneuma plays an important role, so I don't think she will cause any more trouble.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now that Elysia and Pneuma are connected... Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me it's a secret?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No. It isn't a secret. I'll explain. Since the two places became connected, Elysia and Pneuma have begun influencing each other.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If Pneuma is endangered, Elysia will be endangered too.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: So Lady Hecate will not threaten Pneuma lightly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then why did she threaten you and Pneuma...?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: ...That much, I don't know...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I merely manage Pneuma. I cannot understand the will of an ancient god like Lady Hecate...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course you can't understand. The very idea of understanding a being like that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: There is something you should know. Most gods take a position similar to Lady Hecate's...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't the ancient gods and the Twisted Ones all love this world?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: They share a love for the world, but their treatment of living beings differs greatly. Not all are like Lady Seres, Lady Gaia, or Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: In the Twilight era, the gods grew furious as soon as they discovered living beings who had taken the opposing side. It may seem harsh, but those beings were annihilated.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Along with the gods they served...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: From Lady Hecate's perspective, you, a follower of Lady Iris, may be no different from those people.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: So you must not try to understand gods through human thinking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right... Even so, it's frustrating...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It seems Hayden would like to see you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has something happened on Aie Island?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No. It seems he wants to talk about the hourglasses...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, the Hourglasses of Emotion. There are two left now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The wish for passion and love, and the wish for hope and peace...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I accidentally brought them out of Pneuma, so I'll find them right away.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, please don't overthink things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand what you mean. I'll find a way to resolve it.
(Arche nods in understanding and sees the adventurer off.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I know Arche is worried...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But it bothers me that Hecate created the witches' destinies...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go see Hayden for now.

steps.name: Colors of Emotion (13)
steps.objective: Talk to [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」, then turn in the quest to [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Hello, adventurer. Marie, you should say hello too.
(When Hayden speaks to the doll in his arms, Marie lifts her head slightly and gives a quiet wave.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Hayden. Hello, Marie. But Marie, you just moved as though it were perfectly normal.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Oh...
(Looking flustered, Hayden covers Marie's eyes with his hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, about the hourglass...
(Hayden stares intently at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it, Hayden?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: You don't look very happy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you're a spirit, so I suppose I can tell you. It concerns Pneuma... Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain what happened when you visited a place called Elysia.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: After hearing your story, %s, I understand how Circe could control me as she pleased.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: A witch using... power received from a god...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Do you happen to know where Circe is?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I haven't learned anything since that incident.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I see.
(As Hayden looks startled by a sudden thought, Marie raises a hand in his arms.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I've thought of a way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A way?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: For a little while now, I've felt something strange around the island, including the theater.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I thought it might be an hourglass, so Glaucos, Scylla, and I searched as carefully as grooming a Priring's fur, but we failed.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Only you can find it, but I thought we might at least work out where it was.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: So that you could find it right away when you came.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... Simply looking for it won't work, but you have another way?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The emotions have sunk deep and remain hidden. We need something that can stir them.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: With that, the Hourglass of Emotion will surface. Please bring me the objects you encountered during the trials in Elysia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There were two kinds of trial fragments... Fragments of Joy and Fragments of Sorrow...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Fragments won't do. Bring me one large piece of each.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go get them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...How do I get large ones? I should ask Irfan in Elysia... To think I have to enter the trials again...)

steps.name: Colors of Emotion (14)
steps.objective:
1. Complete the regular quests [Crafting the Joy of Trials] and [Crafting the Sorrow of Trials] to obtain <Joy of Trials> and <Sorrow of Trials>.
2. Take <Joy of Trials> and <Sorrow of Trials> to [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」 and report to him.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You acted as though you would never return, yet here you are because you need something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I thought you might bring desert sand or something... Now, speak. Your face makes your dislike of me clear, but who knows...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Perhaps I can offer an answer to your story...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly tell Irfan about the hourglasses.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: If it concerns Pneuma, I should help.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Bring the Trial Fragments of Sorrow and Joy you encountered in the Black Moon Trial and the Trial of the Earth.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Then I will make larger ones for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How many of each do I need?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Bring three of each. I can make them for you whenever you need.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: But before you enter the trials, tell me you intend to bring the trial fragments. Only then will they appear before you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Is that difficult to understand?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It is a sort of quest. Be careful: if you go without telling me, the trial fragments will not appear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I think that explains it... Well, will you do it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... I hate the trials, but I have no choice...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I will exchange the fragments as soon as you bring them. Then go straight to where you need them.

steps.name: Colors of Emotion (15)
steps.objective: Defeat [Glaucos] in 「Theater Eugamon」 and obtain the <Red Hourglass>. Then turn in the quest to [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: It's amazing to see objects like these tokens of a trial.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do we do now?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I've already dug a hole. We'll throw them in and bury them.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Then the feelings of joy and sorrow from overcoming the trials will dissolve and flow into the theater.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm a little doubtful, but shall we try?)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Now, throw them here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...
(You throw the Trial's Joy and Sorrow into the hole Marie points to.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will this work...?
(Marie takes a shovel and fills the hole with soil. A moment later, the huge theater entrance in front of Hayden trembles.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-What was that...?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I think it's ready... Go inside the theater. You should be able to find the hourglass now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? By the way, Hayden...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you no longer trying to hide that Marie can move?
(Apparently startled, Marie looks at Hayden and collapses where she stands, pretending to be dead.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... Never mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll just pretend I don't know.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Marie will be happy too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right... I'll go find the hourglass, then.
(After wandering for some time through the various stages of the Eugamon Theater, you see something glowing red in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that it? Oh, yes. That's it...
(The moment you take hold of the hourglass filled with red sand, unfamiliar emotions flow into %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels strangely hot... So these are feelings of passion and love...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They seem to suit Glaucos, the theater's owner.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Time to go.

steps.name: Colors of Emotion (16)
steps.objective: Talk to [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」, then turn in the quest to [Atkina] in 「Burning Wheel」.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Well done.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: While you were coming here, %s, the sand inside the hourglass reacted to your power, %s, and disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Then what should we do?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Don't worry. The sand of emotion naturally mingled with the spirits returning to Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Only one left now...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The green one, right? Mir should know about that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know where Mir is?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Apparently she's been visiting the ancient dragon often lately. His work has taken him far from where he usually stays...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Atkina...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The dragon's name was Atkina, wasn't it? Is he at the Burning Wheel...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I know the place. I'll see you later, Hayden. I'll go talk with Mir.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Goodbye, adventurer.

steps.name: Colors of Emotion (17)
steps.objective: Talk to [Atkina] in 「Burning Wheel」, obtain <Joy of Trials> and <Sorrow of Trials>, then report to [Mir] inside 「Twilight Cathedral」.

lines.text: (Entering the Burning Wheel, you see the enormous dragon Atkina in the distance. He seems to be talking with someone nearby.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Atkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Welcome, %s. It has been a while.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Long time no see, adventurer.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Have you been well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I have.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I was just talking with Mir. Now, where did you say you went to eat so much?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Oh, Atkina. You make it sound as though I only travel around to eat. I don't! %s will get the wrong idea.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Is that not what you do?
Rumble.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I was wondering when I would hear that sound. Whatever else may be true, the gods must have blessed your stomach. It has already surpassed a dragon's.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Atkina! How can you say such things so casually to a girl...? That my stomach has awakened or transcended...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Do not deny the truth.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this conversation like this because Mir is here?)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Well, that's true. But did you know, Atkina?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You have seen something interesting, haven't you?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: In a city called Glaston on the continent of Freios, they hold eating contests. Residents pay admission to watch them.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: How curious. To pay money to watch such a thing... Why not try it sometime?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Hehe, perhaps after I retire? I'm joking. How about we go watch together during my next vacation?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Shall we? Oh, that reminds me. I had forgotten about the food Io brought in such quantities... You should join Mir and have some.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wasn't that the food that made you angry when you tasted it...?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I was not angry. It simply wasn't to my taste. There are other dishes too, so don't be shy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Thank you for the food.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I was so busy talking with Mir that I forgot to ask about you. I cannot sense much of the outside world from here.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Oh, I was just about to tell you, Atkina...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know too, Mir?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes. That's why I came to see Atkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Tell me, then. I suspect it is no ordinary matter...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Well...
(Atkina's expression hardens as he listens to Mir and %s.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Now that I hear the name, I think I remember. A god who rules over witches? Such an absurd thing could not...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The one I knew...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: She has already interfered with Pneuma. Witches influenced by her power are appearing, and a gate to the Demon Realm is about to connect.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Daphne's movements seem somewhat different, though...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure either.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I would like to go out and help, but maintaining this place is more difficult than I expected. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Atkina, please don't push yourself too hard.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Very well. I will not overdo it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm investigating, so I'll tell you right away if I learn anything else.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: If Lady Gaia awakens, this place should sustain itself... Very well, I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mir, Hayden told me to ask. Do you know where the hourglass is?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Oh, yes. I do! It's in the Twilight Cathedral.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Wait, %s. Please listen for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I was passing through Lifthrasir when I sensed something strange toward the cathedral, so I went to look...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I asked the spirits flying in from Pneuma, and they confirmed it was an Hourglass of Emotion. I even went inside the cathedral to see if I could find it, but of course I couldn't.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm the one who brought them out of Pneuma, so I have to find them.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: There's something we need first. Please bring me what you brought Hayden. What was it called?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Trial's Joy and Sorrow...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes, that sounds right. Bring those to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go get them and bring them back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Atkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I hope nothing untoward happens.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your kind wishes.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: %s, I'll go to the cathedral while you do that! I'll hide near the roof to avoid the devils, so come there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Going back to Elysia is a bother, but it can't be helped.)

steps.name: Colors of Emotion (18)
steps.objective: Defeat [Morgana] in 「Twilight Cathedral」 and obtain the <Green Hourglass>. Then report to [Lif] in 「Lifthrasir」.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Oh, adventurer! If we talk too long here, the devils may attack you and make you use the Resurrection Essence you've been saving for later.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: So I'll finish quickly. One, two, three!! All done.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Now you can find the remaining green hourglass in the cathedral. I'll send you off without another word, so go straight to the final room and find it! Understood?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: And give what you find to the local village chief! Then I'm done! I'll be going! You don't need to hear that again, do you?
(At the far end of a space filled with holy light stands an hourglass glowing green.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why didn't I notice it last time? It's so easy to spot...
(The moment you take the green hourglass, various emotions flow into %s, just as when you found the red one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's warm... The wish for hope and peace... I suppose everyone wishes for the same things from the gods...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe it's even stronger because this is a cathedral.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Time to go...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why did she tell me to take this to Director Lif?

steps.name: Colors of Emotion (19)
steps.objective: Talk to [Lif] in 「Lifthrasir」, then return to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, what brings you here?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh, could it be...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't come to consult you about plans for my retirement...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh, come now. Did you think I was going to say that?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I was going to ask whether you'd brought what Mir requested.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't realize... Here you are.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's all right. Hehe. I was about to say something similar.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Residents of Lifthrasir receive all sorts of benefits recognized throughout Freios, so do give it some thought.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: This isn't an opportunity that comes every day! Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Anyway, this...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: An hourglass? An hourglass glowing green... Was something like this in the cathedral?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh... This...
(Lif gazes at the hourglass hesitantly.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I thought it had been too long for me to remember... But the feelings that person wanted to protect are coming back so vividly...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Where was this originally?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wonder if I should tell you...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's all right. I know how to keep a secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A spirit told me to bring it to you, so you must be no ordinary person...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Neither are you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... Then I'll tell you. When I left the spirit world, some emotions followed me out, turned into hourglasses, and scattered everywhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I have to find them and take them to a spirit. Wait, if I have to give it to you...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: There is a story in our village. An elf village's guardian spirit lived for so long that it eventually began living like an ordinary elf...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You say something that sounds like a legend so casually. Are you talking about yourself?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe. Who knows?
(With an awkward smile, Lif cradles the hourglass. Soon, the green sand inside begins to glow and flow out.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: O goddess, guide this unworthy elf... I will strive never to repeat my mistakes... Now, return...
(At Lif's words, the sparkling green sand rises into the sky, circles the village once, and disappears somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: There, all done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you do that?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I am Lifthrasir's village chief. I have simply been blessed with the ability to communicate with spirits.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll keep the empty hourglass... I mean, we'll keep it in the Song of the Stars. I asked Mir if that was all right, and she said yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? I'll feel safe leaving it in the Song of the Stars. A spirit who delivers the gods' messages has approved it, after all.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, village work is piling up, so I need to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Director.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'd like to tell you more about the business, %s, but I'm sorry, I'm busy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can tell me about the business next time. Wait, business? What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's gone. Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I've collected all the hourglasses, I should let Arche in Pneuma know...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thanks to you, %s, the emotions inside the hourglasses have returned. The spirits are full of life again too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You worked hard. How are you feeling now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm feeling better. Coming to Pneuma has definitely eased my anxiety.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Even so, you should get some rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose I should. Who knows what will happen next...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Shall I call the Aerura again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I like how soft the Aerura are.
(Reading the loneliness on %s's face, Arche nods. Soon, several Aerura roaming Pneuma's skies approach %s.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The Aerura have come to offer you a place beside them. Rest well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I fall asleep here, won't it inconvenience you, Arche...?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Hehe, don't worry about that. I'll be traveling around Pneuma to check on the spirits in the meantime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You can sleep soundly. Kairos and Chronos will come wake you when it's time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then shall I stop worrying about everything else and close my eyes for a while...?)
(And so, you drift into a deep sleep, awaiting a day when you can wake feeling at least a little more refreshed...)
